name: Bard
description: Bards are charismatic performers and storytellers whose voice and presence rally allies and unbalance foes. They draw on the domains of Grace and Codex — social grace and the lore that gives words their power.

classFeature.name: Rally
classFeature.text: When you make a roll to inspire, taunt, or distract a creature, you can spend a Hope to give an ally within Close range an additional Hope, which they may spend on their next roll.

hopeFeature.name: Make a Scene
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to temporarily distract a target within Far range, giving them a -2 penalty to their next reaction roll.

name: Druid
description: Druids are guardians of the natural world whose magic flows from the cycles of growth, decay, and renewal. They draw on the domains of Sage and Arcana to shape the wild and walk in the shape of beasts.

classFeature.name: Beastform
classFeature.text: Spend a Hope to transform into a beast you have studied. While in beastform, your physical traits and damage are determined by the beast; you retain your own mental traits and your Stress, Hope, and Hit Points.

hopeFeature.name: Evolution
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to gain advantage on a roll that uses Strength, Agility, or Instinct as you channel the wild for an extra burst of vitality.

name: Guardian
description: Guardians are unyielding protectors whose presence on the line is a comfort to allies and a problem for everyone else. They draw on the domains of Valor and Blade to shield those who cannot shield themselves.

classFeature.name: Unstoppable
classFeature.text: Mark a Stress to ignore the damage from one incoming attack, reducing it to zero. You can use this feature once per encounter.

hopeFeature.name: Frontline Tank
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Armor Slots. While you have Armor Slots remaining, you can use them to reduce incoming damage as usual.

name: Ranger
description: Rangers are wilderness experts whose precision and patience let them strike at long range and survive where others cannot. They draw on the domains of Bone and Sage to hunt and to read the land.

classFeature.name: Ranger's Focus
classFeature.text: Spend a Hope to mark a target you can see as your Focus. While your Focus is active, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against that target. You can change your Focus during a rest, or for free at the start of a new encounter.

hopeFeature.name: Hold Them Off
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to roll your damage dice twice for an attack against your Focus, taking the higher result.

name: Rogue
description: Rogues are quick-witted opportunists whose value comes from being where no one expects them. They draw on the domains of Midnight and Grace to slip through shadows and through conversations alike.

classFeature.name: Sneak Attack
classFeature.text: When you succeed on an attack against a creature that is unaware of you, or that you have advantage against, add an additional 1d6 phy damage. This bonus increases as you gain tiers.

hopeFeature.name: Rogue's Dodge
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to grant yourself a +2 bonus to Evasion until you make an attack or until your next rest.

name: Seraph
description: Seraphs are divine champions whose convictions are made manifest in light and steel. They draw on the domains of Splendor and Valor to heal, to ward, and to strike for the powers they serve.

classFeature.name: Prayer Dice
classFeature.text: At the start of each session, gain a pool of d4 Prayer Dice equal to your level. You can spend any number of Prayer Dice when an ally within Close range makes a roll, rolling them and adding the total to that roll. Replenish the pool at your next long rest.

hopeFeature.name: Life Support
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

name: Sorcerer
description: Sorcerers are vessels of innate magic whose power surges from heritage, chance, or accident rather than study. They draw on the domains of Arcana and Midnight to shape raw forces and to keep their workings hidden.

classFeature.name: Volatile Magic
classFeature.text: When you make a spell attack roll, you may mark a Stress to add a d6 to your damage roll. If your Hope die comes up odd, you also take damage equal to half the d6 result (rounded down).

hopeFeature.name: Arcane Sense
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to extend your awareness through nearby magic; for the next scene, you can sense the presence and rough nature of any magical effect or item within Far range.

name: Warrior
description: Warriors are disciplined combatants whose mastery of arms is honed by training, drill, or hard experience. They draw on the domains of Blade and Bone to dominate the battlefield through skill and tactics.

classFeature.name: Attack of Opportunity
classFeature.text: When an adversary leaves Melee range with you, you can spend a Hope to make an attack against them as they go.

hopeFeature.name: No Mercy
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to gain advantage on your next attack roll.

name: Wizard
description: Wizards are scholarly mages whose power comes from disciplined study of arcane principles. They draw on the domains of Codex and Splendor to weave precise, measured spells and to mend with the same intellect.

classFeature.name: Strange Patterns
classFeature.text: Once per session, choose a number between 1 and 12. When you roll your Hope or Fear die and the result matches your chosen number, treat the roll as if it had come up critical.

hopeFeature.name: Not This Time
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to force an adversary within Far range to reroll an attack against you or an ally within Close range.
